git.gitignore_content:
# Framework Stata project
# Data files stay out of git. Do-files, settings.do, and documentation are
# committed; data and logs are not.
#
# This project holds restricted data. Everything under a private/ folder stays
# on the machine that may hold it. Only reviewed, de-identified files go in
# public/ folders.

# Stata data and session files
*.dta
*.log
*.smcl
*.stswp

# Restricted data
/inputs/private/
/outputs/private/
**/private/**
**/*_private/**
**/sensitive/**

# Keep the folder structure and its documentation
!/inputs/**/README.md
!/inputs/**/.gitkeep
!/outputs/**/README.md
!/outputs/**/.gitkeep

# Secrets and credentials
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
**/credentials/**
**/secrets/**
*.key
*.pem
*.p12
*.pfx

# Logs, cache, and scratch work
**/logs/**
**/cache/**
**/scratch/**
**/tmp/**
slurm-*.out

# System files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
*~
*.tmp
*.bak
